tasks.instruction: The blue tiger sits on a low wooden stool and lifts one leg straight out toward the viewer, pressing that foot flat against the lens so four toes and yellow pads fill the frame.
tasks.camera: Extreme close-up, foot thrust toward camera, stool and torso blurred behind
tasks.visibility_requirement: The raised sole and all four toes are fully visible, unobstructed by the other leg.
tasks.intent_zh: 坐姿将脚掌正对镜头，展示四趾与黄色肉垫。

tasks.instruction: Balanced on a narrow garden beam, the tiger lifts one hind foot behind and twists to look back at it, sole angled upward.
tasks.camera: Low three-quarter rear view, beam cutting diagonally, sky behind
tasks.visibility_requirement: The lifted rear sole is clear and all four toes visible against the sky.
tasks.intent_zh: 在窄梁上保持平衡，回身查看抬起的脚掌。

tasks.instruction: Lying on a yoga mat, the tiger pulls one knee to its chest and rolls that leg outward, exposing the upturned sole while the other leg stays long on the mat.
tasks.camera: High overhead shot looking down at the mat, body foreshortened
tasks.visibility_requirement: The upturned sole faces the overhead camera fully, all four toes separated and clear.
tasks.intent_zh: 仰卧拉伸，将一只脚掌翻向俯视镜头。

tasks.instruction: The tiger perches on a high diving board edge, one leg dangling, the other foot hooked over the board with the sole turned up to the viewer below.
tasks.camera: Worm's-eye view from below the board, sky and pool far away
tasks.visibility_requirement: The hooked foot's sole is presented toward the camera with all toes unobstructed.
tasks.intent_zh: 坐在跳板边缘，脚掌朝下翻向仰视镜头。

tasks.instruction: Kneeling on one knee beside a chalk drawing, the tiger extends the other leg backward and lifts that foot high, sole facing the camera.
tasks.camera: Side-low angle at ground level, chalk marks in foreground
tasks.visibility_requirement: The lifted rear sole and its four toes are fully visible, not hidden by the body.
tasks.intent_zh: 单膝跪地，向后抬脚将脚掌展示给镜头。

tasks.instruction: Leaning back in a hammock, the tiger lifts both legs but turns one foot so its sole faces the side viewer while the other foot rests crossed.
tasks.camera: Side view at hammock height, fabric curving through frame
tasks.visibility_requirement: One sole is sideways to camera and fully visible; the resting foot is not counted.
tasks.intent_zh: 吊床侧躺，一只脚掌侧向镜头清晰可见。

tasks.instruction: Sitting on a skateboard at a skatepark, the tiger plants one foot on the deck and raises the other leg toward the lens, sole flat.
tasks.camera: Ground-level front view, skate ramp curves behind
tasks.visibility_requirement: The raised sole is flat toward the lens, four toes spread and fully visible.
tasks.intent_zh: 坐在滑板上，将一只脚掌平举向镜头。

tasks.instruction: The tiger climbs a rope ladder, pausing to hook one foot on a rung while looking down; the camera above sees that sole from behind.
tasks.camera: High angle from above looking down the ladder
tasks.visibility_requirement: The hooked sole faces the high camera with all four toes visible between rungs.
tasks.intent_zh: 攀爬绳梯，俯视镜头看到勾住的脚掌。

tasks.instruction: Stretching on a kitchen counter, the tiger lies on its back with one leg propped against a cabinet, sole facing the viewer.
tasks.camera: Frontal waist-height view, cabinets framing the image
tasks.visibility_requirement: The propped sole is unobstructed and all four toes are visible against the cabinet.
tasks.intent_zh: 躺在台面上把脚抵住柜子，脚掌正对镜头。

tasks.instruction: The tiger crouches on a rocky ledge and lifts one hind foot onto a higher stone, sole turned outward to the camera.
tasks.camera: Low side angle on the ledge, distant valley behind
tasks.visibility_requirement: The outward sole and four toes are clearly visible, not merged with the stone.
tasks.intent_zh: 蹲在岩边，把一只脚踩上高处石头并外翻脚掌。

tasks.instruction: Reclining on a picnic blanket, the tiger raises one foot toward a friend and flexes the sole wide open, toes spread.
tasks.camera: Close low angle across the blanket, grass around
tasks.visibility_requirement: The flexed sole is fully open to camera with all four toes separated.
tasks.intent_zh: 躺在野餐毯上，向镜头张开脚掌和四趾。

tasks.instruction: The tiger sits on a swing and pushes off the ground, one foot extended toward the camera as it swings forward, sole visible.
tasks.camera: Front tracking view at swing height, motion in ropes
tasks.visibility_requirement: The extended sole faces the camera clearly, toes readable despite the swing.
tasks.intent_zh: 荡秋千前推，一只脚掌伸向镜头。

tasks.instruction: Standing in a shallow stream, the tiger lifts one foot from the water and turns the sole toward the camera, toes dripping.
tasks.camera: Low water-level view, ripples and rocks foreground
tasks.visibility_requirement: The wet sole and four toes are fully visible above the waterline.
tasks.intent_zh: 站在溪水中抬起一只脚，脚掌朝镜头展示。

tasks.instruction: The tiger lies on its side on a couch, one leg raised and bent so the sole faces the room, toes relaxed.
tasks.camera: Wide living-room view from floor level, couch dominating frame
tasks.visibility_requirement: The bent sole faces the room clearly and all four toes are visible.
tasks.intent_zh: 侧躺沙发，弯曲抬脚展示脚掌。

tasks.instruction: Perched on a tall bar stool, the tiger crosses one ankle over the other knee and tilts the sole up toward the viewer.
tasks.camera: Eye-level close view, bar counter blurred behind
tasks.visibility_requirement: The tilted sole faces the camera fully, four toes clear of the opposite leg.
tasks.intent_zh: 坐在高脚凳上架腿，把脚掌翻向镜头。

tasks.instruction: The tiger does a slow cartwheel in a park and freezes mid-turn, one leg lifted high with its sole facing the camera.
tasks.camera: Side action shot frozen mid-motion, trees blurred
tasks.visibility_requirement: The raised sole is sharply visible and all four toes clear against the background.
tasks.intent_zh: 侧手翻中途定格，高举的脚掌正对镜头。

tasks.instruction: Sitting on a dock with legs over the water, the tiger swings one foot up onto the dock, sole turned up to the camera.
tasks.camera: Low dock-level view, water reflecting below
tasks.visibility_requirement: The upturned sole rests on the dock fully visible with all four toes.
tasks.intent_zh: 坐在码头，把脚抬上木板，脚掌朝上展示。

tasks.instruction: The tiger kneels on a bed and lifts one lower leg behind, foot sole facing the camera over its shoulder.
tasks.camera: Rear three-quarter view at bed height, pillows around
tasks.visibility_requirement: The lifted sole faces the rear camera clearly, all four toes unobstructed.
tasks.intent_zh: 跪在床上向后抬脚，脚掌越过肩膀朝向镜头。

tasks.instruction: Leaning against a wall, the tiger lifts one straight leg to hip height and presses the sole flat toward the viewer.
tasks.camera: Frontal eye-level shot, wall texture behind
tasks.visibility_requirement: The flat sole is fully visible with four toes spread, nothing blocking it.
tasks.intent_zh: 靠墙抬高直腿，脚掌平推镜头。

tasks.instruction: The tiger sits in a camping chair and props one foot on the opposite knee, tilting the sole toward a nearby lantern.
tasks.camera: Warm side view at chair height, tent fabric behind
tasks.visibility_requirement: The tilted sole is lit and fully visible, all four toes clear.
tasks.intent_zh: 坐在露营椅上架脚，脚掌被灯光照亮展示。

tasks.instruction: Hanging from a playground bar, the tiger swings one leg up and hooks the knee, presenting the sole to the camera.
tasks.camera: Low angle from beneath the bars, sky behind
tasks.visibility_requirement: The hooked sole is clearly visible from below with all four toes.
tasks.intent_zh: 悬挂单杠，勾起膝盖将脚掌展示给下方镜头。

tasks.instruction: The tiger lies on a skateboard rolling slowly, one leg lifted so the sole faces the following camera.
tasks.camera: Low front tracking shot on smooth pavement
tasks.visibility_requirement: The lifted sole stays fully visible to the following camera, four toes clear.
tasks.intent_zh: 躺滑板上滑行，抬起脚掌朝向跟拍镜头。

tasks.instruction: Squatting beside a campfire, the tiger shifts weight to one leg and lifts the other heel, turning that sole outward to the camera.
tasks.camera: Low firelit side angle, embers glowing
tasks.visibility_requirement: The outward sole is lit by firelight and fully visible with four toes.
tasks.intent_zh: 蹲在篝火旁，外侧脚掌被火光映亮展示。

tasks.instruction: The tiger steps out of a car and lifts one foot onto the door sill, sole facing the camera through the open door.
tasks.camera: Exterior low angle through open car door
tasks.visibility_requirement: The sole on the sill is fully visible, four toes clear of the door frame.
tasks.intent_zh: 下车时脚踩门槛，脚掌透过车门朝向镜头。

tasks.instruction: Doing a handstand against a wall, the tiger spreads its legs and angles one sole toward the camera.
tasks.camera: Wide frontal shot, wall behind, floor below
tasks.visibility_requirement: The angled sole is fully visible and all four toes separate clearly.
tasks.intent_zh: 倒立靠墙，分开双腿将一只脚掌转向镜头。

tasks.instruction: The tiger sits on a staircase and stretches one leg down several steps, sole turned up toward the camera at the bottom.
tasks.camera: Low angle up the stairs, steps receding
tasks.visibility_requirement: The sole at the bottom of the stretch faces the low camera with four toes visible.
tasks.intent_zh: 坐在楼梯上伸腿，脚掌朝下方镜头翻起。

tasks.instruction: Reclining on a rooftop, the tiger lifts both feet but rotates one leg so its sole faces the drone camera above.
tasks.camera: Aerial drone view looking straight down over rooftops
tasks.visibility_requirement: One sole faces the drone fully with all four toes visible; the other foot is not counted.
tasks.intent_zh: 躺在屋顶，把一只脚掌转向头顶的无人机镜头。

tasks.instruction: The tiger crouches inside a cardboard box and pokes one foot out through a cut hole, sole facing the camera.
tasks.camera: Close floor-level view of the box opening
tasks.visibility_requirement: The protruding sole is fully visible through the hole with all four toes.
tasks.intent_zh: 蹲在纸箱中，从洞口伸出脚掌朝向镜头。

tasks.instruction: Leaning back on a gym ball, the tiger balances with one foot lifted off the floor, sole turned to the camera.
tasks.camera: Low side view at ball height, gym floor behind
tasks.visibility_requirement: The lifted sole is fully visible and all four toes clear of the ball.
tasks.intent_zh: 仰靠健身球保持平衡，抬起脚掌展示。

tasks.instruction: The tiger lies on its stomach on a rug and bends one knee up, sole facing the ceiling camera while the other leg stays flat.
tasks.camera: Overhead view straight down onto the rug
tasks.visibility_requirement: The bent sole faces the ceiling camera with all four toes fully visible.
tasks.intent_zh: 俯卧地毯，屈膝将脚掌朝天花板镜头展示。
